projectMetadata.description: A comprehensive web suite for independent USANA distributors, featuring a public-facing landing page and private, offline-first business tools.

architecture.frontend: Vanilla JS, HTML, CSS (Vite build tool)

items.label: Shared components dir (NavBar, ToolShell, DataTable, ImportWizard)
Consolidate Landing/Product/Business into shared SectionRenderer (decided this session — not yet built)
items.instructions: Refactor src/landing/main.js, src/product/main.js, src/business/main.js into one shared section-rendering module per the 'Public Page Rendering' decision. Needed before adding video/YouTube sections.

items.label: Receipt/Ledger/Prospect CSV import/export actually wired (FR-B6)
items.instructions: ToolShell renders Export/Import CSV buttons in all three tools, but none of the three attach click handlers or import csv.js/ImportWizard.js. FR-B6 and §14 Rule 5 are currently unmet.

items.label: Reconcile Purchase.lineItems field names with spec §6.2
items.instructions: Spec: {productName, quantity, unitPrice}. Code (receipts): {desc, qty, price}. Pick one, update the other.

items.label: Reconcile paymentStatus enum with spec §6.2
items.instructions: Spec enum: paid|pending|partial. Code: Paid|Unpaid. Decide and align.

items.label: Add missing Prospect fields per spec §6.2
items.instructions: spec includes `source` and `responseOutcome`; not present in the form or saved record. Also confirm whether 'inactive' status (referenced in board logic but unreachable from the form) should be a real, selectable status.

items.label: Render guidance-rules.json _meta.source and _meta.disclaimer in Product Guidance UI
items.instructions: Data already carries source/disclaimer; generateProtocol() in guidance/main.js never renders either. Required by the project's own decision to preserve provenance and disclaimers.

items.label: Portrait/Landscape Composition Pass
items.instructions: Manually test all views on mobile (portrait) and desktop (landscape). Verify tables scroll horizontally without breaking layout, sidebars collapse, touch targets are adequate.

items.label: Accessibility (a11y) Pass
items.instructions: Full keyboard navigation (Tab/Enter/Space). WCAG AA contrast check. prefers-reduced-motion respected on landing progress-rail animation.

items.label: Centralized BASE_URL-aware asset-path helper adopted everywhere
items.instructions: Confirmed bug: app/tools/receipts, ledger, and prospects index.html all hardcode /styles/tokens.css and /favicon-*.png as root-absolute paths, matching the same class of bug already found in the landing page CTAs and products.json image paths. Build the centralized helper decided this session and apply it everywhere before this phase closes.

items.label: Initial GitHub Pages Deployment
items.instructions: Confirm .github/workflows/deploy.yml has completed at least one successful run and the site is live and correctly serving the Vite bundle at the expected gh-pages URL.

openDecisions.text: Single-admin / no-auth assumption for the Tools workspace.
openDecisions.resolution: Confirmed Alpha is single-user/local. No auth or backend now; architecture must preserve boundaries for future multi-user extension (storage-adapter as the sole seam).
Reviewed this session. Not a shell — functional, but has schema drift from spec §6.2 and no CSV import/export wiring. See the new Phase 3 items this generated.

Source confirmed: 'Comprehensive Guide to Nutritional Product Recommendation', compiled/reviewed by the project owner. Uplines with USANA compliance familiarity have reviewed the concept and agreed. Tool remains private/local for the Alpha per this session's decision.

openDecisions.text: Brand assets / final palette not yet confirmed.
USANA distributor policy review for any PUBLIC content (site-wide, not the private Guidance tool specifically).
Which React UI ecosystem/library (if any) to adopt for the design system.
openDecisions.resolution: Direction confirmed (move toward React, choose deliberately, smallest appropriate ecosystem, public vs. tools may differ) — specific library not yet selected.

openDecisions.text: Undocumented `diagnostic-id`/'Ghost Log' identifier (15661635) appearing in NavBar.js, guidance/main.js, and all three tool HTML files' <meta> tags.
openDecisions.blocks: Phase 4 (should be documented or removed before polish/launch)
